reviewed_by: Claude #1095 implementer; all four defects independently reproduced on 7495a04 by a separate Claude validation subagent (issues/work-goals/validation.md); an independent diff review is still required before merge
reason: Fixes #1095. Work page: Link item PATCHes with the expected_revision it just read (one re-read on 409) and refuses an item that became Done, so a concurrent claim is reported, not overwritten; the operator's check-in status choice is kept per item across live updates and an untouched status is omitted so Core keeps the latest; while a blocker is entered the Status select shows Blocked (disabled) with a described hint. Provider work_check_in, gateway work.check_in and Butler check_in_work_item now say a blocker saves Blocked. Goals: ChatGoalService.write refuses resume of a step- or token-exhausted goal with 409 before any change (as for time), except restart recovery (allow_pending_recovery), which must still finish the turn that ran on the last step/tokens; dispatch_running_goal treats GoalBudgetConfigurationError as expected instead of logging chat.goal.dispatch_failed. Python: test_chat_goals.py (new: 409 parity for step/token/time over HTTP with the real dispatcher and no diagnostic, the restart-recovery exemption, the dispatch budget race, and restart recovery of a final step/token turn; the step/token and dispatch cases fail on 7495a04), test_chat_stream_follow.py (restart-recovery goal gating), test_work_gateway.py (gateway Work tools), and six test_work.py node IDs: the new blocker-rule test covering the provider, gateway and Butler check-in descriptions, plus the check-in, revision, provider-tool and API tests around the changed code. Frontend: WorkPage.test.tsx (revision-safe link, Done refusal, kept status, blocker form). Playwright: work-import real-Core journey, extended with a blocked check-in, at desktop and Chromium/WebKit 390.
exclusions: Run locally but not selected because they hold failures already present on 7495a04 that this diff does not touch (unawaited async store/catalog calls in the tests, and a harness runtime-switch fixture that changes a runtime before the chat service is initialized): test_control_assistant_work.py (36 such failures; Butler's check-in schema change is asserted by the selected test_work.py blocker test), test_harness_chat_goals.py (2, test_goal_resume_uses_saved_next_harness_in_same_chat; its other tests, including budget pauses and resume, pass with this diff), test_work.py::test_work_project_batch_links_existing_projects_and_prevents_cycles, test_butler_capabilities.py (1) and test_all_tool_failure_guidance.py (2), which only name Work tools. real-core.spec.ts work hub area stays excluded (owned by the real-core-e2e repair). Other work-import profiles (320/430/compact) are the same journey at other widths. No native, settings or product-knowledge (docs/*.md) changes; the Butler workflow registry UI call inventory is unchanged.
